definitions.explanation: Being skillful or proficient at something. Used to describe one's strengths or areas of expertise.
Feeling proud or self-satisfied, often shown in one's expression or manner.
A customer who frequently patronizes a business. Used in business contexts.

examples.english: He has a proud/smug look on his face.

notes:
USAGE: {得意|とくい} has three main meanings. Most commonly used to describe what one is good at.

FORMS:
- {得意|とくい}な〜 (na-adjective: good at ~)
- {得意|とくい} (noun: one's forte, specialty)
- {得意|とくい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become proud/smug)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{得意|とくい}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (to be good at ~)
- {得意|とくい}⟦{科目|かもく}→科目：00163_kamoku⟧ (best subject)
- {得意|とくい}⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧ (area of expertise)
- ⟦{得意先|とくいさき}→得意先：21791_tokuisaki⟧/⟦{得意客|とくいきゃく}→得意客：noentry⟧ (regular customer)
- {得意|とくい}⟦{満面|まんめん}→満面：27881_manmen⟧ (looking very proud)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ (bad at, weak point) - opposite of sense 1

Note: When someone says they're {得意|とくい} at something in Japanese, they're not bragging - it's a straightforward statement of ability.
